props.caption: The acquired layer installs robots, vision and conveyors into working factory lines.

items.note: Pyroclastic currents ran 5–7 kilometres down five ravines while authorities closed RN-14 and moved exposed communities.
Operators reconnected the island’s grid while UNE still forecast a 2,195 MW peak shortfall.
A beach strike killed seven by Russia’s count; verified footage leaves direct impact and air-defence interception unresolved.
Agile Robots bought a majority of XNG Automation, adding a local integration bench rather than a new robot factory.
Iran and Oman exchanged route concepts, but no signed lane, effective date or operational maritime notice exists.

items.kicker: Hormuz Talks Still Lack a Navigable Text
items.what: Iran confirms map exchanges with Oman, while reported lane and service-fee terms still lack a joint announcement, coordinates, an effective date or an operational maritime bulletin.

items.kicker: Paks Keeps the Last Turbine Turning
items.what: No official artifact showed all four Paks units at zero by the 3 August deadline. The 0.54 full-shutdown call settles as a miss.

items.kicker: Congo Opens Its Largest Ebola Centre
items.what: International Medical Corps opened the response’s largest treatment centre in Ituri as the official Bundibugyo tally continued rising beyond the record reported on 2 August.

items.kicker: Kerala Moves Thousands Into Relief Camps
items.what: Monsoon flooding and landslides killed at least 15 people across southern India while authorities housed more than 11,000 residents in hundreds of camps.

items.kicker: Luis Leaves Rain After the Wind
items.what: Tropical Depression Luis crossed northern Luzon and weakened, leaving PAGASA to track residual rain from the low-pressure area and southwest monsoon.

items.kicker: Italy Raises Red Alerts Across 25 Cities
items.what: Italy’s health ministry placed 25 of 27 monitored cities under its highest heat alert as temperatures approached 40°C in parts of the country.

items.kicker: Benin Clears Its New Senate to Organise
items.what: Benin’s Constitutional Court approved the new upper chamber’s internal rules, removing the final procedural barrier to electing its leadership.
